description: activate/extend a subscription via x402 X-PAYMENT header (the POST /subscribe operation; Bearer token required): Solo $9/mo per server by default, or Fleet $29/mo for up to 10 servers with tier=fleet (WO-F-P22-17/RT-20 — the tier parameter is advertised here exactly as in the REST OpenAPI). The embedded check shape (server_config / idp_shape / full_matrix / clients / apply_shims / check) is accepted and stored for hourly re-runs, exactly as REST.
name: subscribe_solo
title: Subscribe (Solo or Fleet)
